links.outcome: Modelled cost per TB case detected at higher prevalence
links.effect: At modelled 1% TB prevalence with participant numbers and total costs held constant, cost per case decreased from USD 5,454 to USD 2,887 (CAD4TBv7) and USD 7,486 to USD 3,975 (CAD4TBv7-CRP).
links.quote: However, the average cost per TB case detected decreased substantially to USD 2,887 (95% UI: USD 2,272–3,587) for the CAD4TBv7 approach and USD 3,975 (95% UI: USD 3,157-4,907) for the CAD4TBv7-CRP approach ( Table 2 ) when compared with the primary analysis.
